Candidate features A=(1,0),B=(0,1),C=(1,1), rewardr=theta dotfeatures. Theta1=(ln3,0) andtheta2=(0,−ln3) both fit the training pair equally.

**Countercase / boundary:** On heldoutA versusC, theta1 gives tieprobability.5; theta2 givesP(A>C)=.75. Training preferences do not uniquely determine rewards or new comparisons. **Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether the3:1 pair fixes both feature weights; recall adding a common constant to every candidate reward leaves pair probabilities unchanged.
